G1.name: Linked layout and source ownership snapshots
G1.cause: Assertions pin pre-L1/L2/M3-H byte counts, table offsets or inline owners although accepted code/data now occupies different linked records.
G1.method: git bisect of the exact first size predicate: LEVEL_IMAGE_SECTORS * 128 <= $680
G1.artifacts: normal build manifest, linked maps/binaries, compiler source
G1.helper: assert.equal/deepEqual over linked artifacts and source inventories

G2.name: M6 compact HUD and lance-lock contract
G2.cause: Tests read old HUD columns/glyph rows or require launching into an empty column; M6 compact fields and §BO intentionally replaced those contracts.
G2.sample: HUD template keeps full LIFE/HULL labels
G2.method: git bisect of the exact hud_ascii first-assertion regex; secondary lock predicate bisected to d165927
G2.artifacts: normal ATR, HUD charset/source, NMOS boss fixture
G2.helper: HUD snapshots / boss fixture / independent raster oracle

G3.name: Checked-load and late-publication fixtures
G3.cause: installRuntimeSegments now performs checked level/L2 setup, warming the level cache; boss late publication also requires a scanline and retains write hooks.
G3.sample: START GAME cold level reads and corruption check
G3.method: git bisect of checked-load side effect in installRuntimeSegments; current cold/hot/corruption tests exercise real reader paths
G3.artifacts: ATR, sector-reader, L2/content overlays, POKEY/VCOUNT Drive fixture

G4.name: Ordinary booster fixture admits LIFE
G4.cause: The ordinary Rapid/Spread/Shield harness starts with a fresh LIFE latch, so its first expected booster becomes LIFE and runBurst sees state=0.
G4.method: binary candidate builds and git bisect; unchanged original helper passes the parent and fails at b2261c9 with the recorded state/pickup/Y tuple

G5.name: Finite-capital and Heavy policy contracts
G5.cause: Fixtures assume 480-coordinate tables, frozen frame parity, small capital debris, no pre-capital clear fence or unchanged M3-H timelines; accepted policies changed all of these.
G5.sample: half-rate Heavy entry with a frozen frame_counter
G5.method: source-predicate git bisects: half-rate gate d7b764c, cached L2 scroll 104a94d, islands db661b9, Heavy-free fence a4e1197
G5.artifacts: compiled level pages, C policy, NMOS frame counter and Director state
G5.helper: direct update_enemy loops / finite geometry resolver / captureTimeline

G6.name: Replaced inline boss-death path
G6.cause: The old inline chain/return-to-fighter cleanup and memory-writer inventory predate the accepted checked disk/DLI death engine.
G6.method: git bisect of the replacement handoff target; replacement coverage is tests/boss-death.test.mjs
G6.artifacts: boss overlay/death runs, DLI source and checked death fixtures

G7.name: Historical evidence and release-bound artifacts
G7.cause: Committed traces, boot/menu captures, curve measurements, media and package evidence describe older ATRs; a normal pending build deliberately supplies no fresh DMA-on measurements.
G7.sample: measured DMA-on fields require artifact-matched trace
G7.method: source-policy git bisect; this locates pending normal-build semantics, not the introduction of each native gameplay observation
G7.artifacts: matching Atari800 source, current ATR, complete canonical trace, menu/boot captures, boss curve and release media
G7.helper: runtime evidence binding / artifact SHA comparison / native clause observers

G9.name: Normal pending evidence treated as measured
G9.cause: Legacy unit expectations copy historical DMA-on measurements into a normal pending manifest, contrary to accepted §BR.
G9.sample: measured DMA-on fields require artifact-matched trace
G9.method: source-policy git bisect plus focused runtime evidence/binding tests, including real strict-release rejection
G9.artifacts: normal manifest and historical report; no new native measurement needed

G8.name: Preview canvas clipping (known tool defect)
G8.cause: The static preview allocates 24×8 rows while the fighter initial Y moved beyond that canvas; changing player_shape therefore leaves the image unchanged.
G8.sample: preview consumes canonical source / shape mutation
G8.method: git bisect of the exact first-row visibility condition using linked-source numeric asserts; 24×8 canvas and initial player Y, not an entire historical suite
G8.artifacts: Node PNG preview and source constants
